title: The Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2611.33088v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Monitoring Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) supports safety and well-being for people living at home, especially older adults, and radar sensing is gaining increasing attention in the field of activity recognition for its ability to ensure privacy in the home while also surpassing technical limitations of other sensing modalities. However, radar-based activity recognition remains constrained by the limited availability of large-scale datasets. We introduce the Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) dataset to addresses the gaps identified in existing work: 1) it expands the scale of available data by providing over eight hours of annotated recordings in which a person performs eight distinct activities; 2) it overcomes room configuration limitations by recording from five different locations in a two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment; and 3) it extends beyond primitive actions to focus on high-level ADLs. translated_title: 基于雷达的日常生活活动数据集
translated_abstract: 监测日常生活活动（ADLs）有助于保障居家生活者的安全与福祉，尤其是老年人。雷达传感技术因能够在保护家庭隐私的同时克服其他传感模式的技术局限，在活动识别领域受到越来越多的关注。然而，基于雷达的活动识别仍受限于大规模数据集的稀缺。我们推出了基于雷达的日常生活活动数据集（R-ADL），以弥补现有工作中发现的不足：1）通过提供超过八小时的标注记录来扩大可用数据规模，其中一个人执行八种不同的活动；2）通过在两室两卫公寓的五个不同位置进行录制，克服了房间配置的限制；3）超越原始动作层次，聚焦于高层次的日常生活活动。除数据外……
tldr: 该论文推出了R-ADL数据集，提供超过八小时、涵盖八种活动和五个居家位置的标注雷达数据，弥补了现有雷达活动识别数据集在规模、房间配置和活动层次上的不足。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the R-ADL dataset, providing over eight hours of annotated radar recordings covering eight activities across five home locations, addressing the gaps in scale, room configuration, and activity granularity of existing radar-based activity recognition datasets.
